chunks.title: hours-and-location
chunks.text: ## Holidays (closed) We are closed on New Year's Day, Independence Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.text: We are **in-network** with these fictional plans for demo purposes: - Maple Health PPO - River Valley Dental HMO - Summit Care Open Access Bring your member ID to your visit.

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.text: ## Payment without insurance We accept cash, credit cards, and CarePlan financing (subject to approval). Payment is due at time of service unless a prior arrangement is documented.

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.text: ## Cancellation policy Please cancel or reschedule at least **24 hours** in advance. Late cancellations may incur a **$50** fee.

chunks.title: insurance-faq
chunks.text: ## Records requests Email **records@brightsmile-demo.example** with your name and date of birth.

chunks.title: new-patient-guide
chunks.text: New Patient Guide (Sample Data) Bring insurance card and arrive 15 minutes early. First visit includes exam, cleaning, and X-rays when needed.

chunks.title: services
chunks.text: # Bright Smile Dental — Services (Sample Data) Bright Smile Dental Clinic offers general and cosmetic dentistry for families in the fictional town of Maple Grove.

chunks.title: services
chunks.text: ## Preventive care - **New patient exam and cleaning** — $129 (sample price). - **Routine cleaning (every 6 months)** — $89 for established patients. - **Fluoride treatment (children)** — $35.

chunks.title: services
chunks.text: ## Restorative - **Composite filling (1 surface)** — from $165. - **Crown (porcelain)** — from $980; we provide a written estimate after exam.

chunks.title: services
chunks.text: ## Emergency We reserve same-day slots for **tooth pain, swelling, or broken teeth**. Call **(555) 014-7721** before 2:00 PM Mon–Fri for same-day availability.

chunks.title: services
chunks.text: ## What we do not offer We do **not** provide orthodontic braces, oral surgery, or sleep-apnea appliances. We refer those cases to partner specialists.

chunks.title: welcome
chunks.text: Bright Smile Dental Clinic — Welcome (Sample Data) Our mission is comfortable, transparent dental care for Maple Grove families. New patients: arrive 15 minutes early with photo ID and insurance card. Forms are also available on our demo website.
